Target Material.cell: calcium-aluminium-rich inclusion — fine-grained CAIs from Allende slabs and one coarse-grained CAI (TS32); BCR-2 is the geostandard

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Fraction of a CAI digestion — "Approximately 30% of the matrix cut", "equivalent to 24% fraction of the whole CAI"

Sample Preparation Method.cell: CAIs extracted from Allende slabs with a stainless steel dental tool and powdered, digested, REEs recovered from the U/TEVA matrix cut, extracted on TODGA and separated by two-step FPLC on Ln-Spec — Materials and Methods, after Tissot et al. (34)
Sample Preparation Method.value: CAIs extracted from Allende slabs with a stainless steel dental tool and powdered, digested, REEs recovered from the U/TEVA matrix cut, extracted on TODGA and separated by two-step FPLC on Ln-Spec

Digestion Acid(s).cell: HF–HNO3–HClO4 attack: 3:1 HF/HNO3 + HClO4; HCl–HNO3 attack: 2:1 HCl:HNO3; final uptake: concentrated HNO3, then 3 M HNO3

Digestion Step.cell: HF–HNO3–HClO4 attack (3:1 HF/HNO3 with a few drops of HClO4, hot plate, 160 °C, 2 weeks); HCl–HNO3 attack (evaporated, then 2:1 HCl:HNO3, 1 week on a hot plate); final uptake (dried, dissolved in concentrated HNO3, diluted in 3 M HNO3 and centrifuged) — the two attacks 'were performed twice to ensure complete digestion'

Digestion Duration.cell: HF–HNO3–HClO4 attack: 2 weeks; HCl–HNO3 attack: 1 week; final uptake: N

Final Solution Matrix.cell: N — standards 'diluted to the same concentration as the sample, in the same acid'; 15–25 ppb for the LREEs, 1.5–10 ppb for Eu and the HREEs

Sample Aliquot Mass or Volume.cell: N — ~30% of the U/TEVA matrix cut, equivalent to 24% of the whole CAI; CAIs of 15–440 mg

Chromatographic Separation Applied.cell: Yes, U/TEVA, TODGA, then two-step FPLC on Ln-Spec resin (70 cm x 1.6 mm, 1.4 ml of 25–50 µm resin, 94 steps, 188 ml, 16 h at 70 °C, 0.17 ml/min). Overall yields >95%
Chromatographic Separation Applied.value: Yes, U/TEVA, TODGA, then two-step FPLC on Ln-Spec resin (70 cm x 1.6 mm, 1.4 ml of 25–50 µm resin, 94 steps, 188 ml, 16 h at 70 °C, 0.17 ml/min). Overall yields >95%

Isotope Dilution Spike.cell: N/A — no isotope dilution spike; mass bias handled by standard-sample bracketing or internal normalization

Instrument Model.cell: Neptune Plus "with the addition of an OnTool booster"
Instrument Model.value: Neptune Plus "with the addition of an OnTool booster"

ICP-MS Type.cell: Multi-collector sector-field ICP-MS [all columns state "multi-collector inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometer"]
ICP-MS Type.value: Multi-collector sector-field ICP-MS [all columns state "multi-collector inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometer"]

Desolvation System.cell: all: Apex Omega desolvating nebulizer — Materials and Methods

Target Species.cell: Ce, Nd, Sm, Eu, Gd, Dy, Er, Yb — isotopic compositions; concentrations of all REEs were also measured

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Masses.cell: 140Ce, 142Ce → Ce; 142Nd, 144Nd, 146Nd → Nd; 148Sm, 152Sm → Sm; 151Eu, 153Eu → Eu; 156Gd, 158Gd → Gd; 162Dy, 163Dy, 164Dy → Dy; 166Er, 168Er → Er; 172Yb, 174Yb → Yb — the ratios of Table 1, ¹⁴²Nd and ¹⁶³Dy named in the text; the full cup configurations are in table S2

Reported Variables and Units.cell: φCe, φNd, φSm, φEu, φGd, φDy, φEr, φYb — ‰/amu relative to the OL-REE standards (Eq. 1)

Collector Configuration.cell: N — static mode for most REEs, a subconfiguration for Dy and Yb; the cup configurations are in table S2

Number of Cycles per Block.cell: main configuration: 40 cycles; subconfiguration: 2, measured at the beginning — Materials and Methods

Integration Time per Cycle.cell: all: 8.184 s — 4.142 s in the subconfiguration

Baseline Measurement Approach.cell: 60 s baseline after 60 s take-up, per measurement — idle time zero between cycles of one configuration, 10 s after a configuration change
Baseline Measurement Approach.value: 60 s baseline after 60 s take-up, per measurement

Analysis Sequence.cell: Standard-sample bracketing — "On average, LREEs were measured nine times bracketed by OL-REE isotope standard spaced apart by 300-s rinsing time"

Internal Standard Element.cell: N/A — mass bias corrected by standard-sample bracketing, internal normalization or a double spike rather than by an added internal standard element

Internal Standard Concentration.cell: N/A — no added internal standard element

Acquisition Pass.cell: main configuration; subconfiguration — for Dy and Yb 'a subconfiguration was used to monitor isobaric interferences'; the cup configurations are in table S2

Number of Acquisition Passes.cell: 2 — the subconfiguration only for Dy and Yb

Mass Bias Correction Strategy.cell: Standard-sample bracketing, each sample ratio normalised to the average of the two bracketing OL-REE standards, diluted to the same concentration in the same acid — 'SSB is advantageous over the double-spike approach because one can distinguish mass-dependent fractionation from isotopic anomalies'
Mass Bias Correction Strategy.value: Standard-sample bracketing, each sample ratio normalised to the average of the two bracketing OL-REE standards, diluted to the same concentration in the same acid

Isotope Ratio Reported.cell: φCe: 142Ce/140Ce; φNd: 146Nd/144Nd; φSm: 152Sm/148Sm; φEu: 153Eu/151Eu; φGd: 158Gd/156Gd; φDy: 164Dy/162Dy; φEr: 168Er/166Er; φYb: 174Yb/172Yb — Table 1 caption; 'the two most abundant isotopes for each REE'

Calibration Strategy per Target Species.cell: Ce, Nd, Sm, Eu, Gd, Dy, Er, Yb: standard-sample bracketing against the OL-REE standard of the same element

value.value: standard-sample bracketing against the OL-REE standard of the same element

Blank / Background Correction Method.cell: Background corrected off-line in a spreadsheet, from the 60 s baseline — 'correcting for background and isobaric interferences'
Blank / Background Correction Method.value: Background corrected off-line in a spreadsheet, from the 60 s baseline

Spectral Interference Corrections Applie.cell: Yes, Er on Dy, and neighbouring-element isotopes generally
Spectral Interference Corrections Applie.value: Yes, Er on Dy, and neighbouring-element isotopes generally

Interfering Species.cell: 162Dy: 162Er; 164Dy: 164Er; other: N — isobars of neighbouring elements in general

Interference Correction Method.cell: 162Dy, 164Dy: 166Er from the subconfiguration, scaled through 166Er/163Dy to the main configuration and multiplied by 162Er/166Er and 164Er/166Er; other: monitoring another isotope of the interfering element and subtracting its intensity at natural abundance — Materials and Methods

value.value: 166Er from the subconfiguration, scaled through 166Er/163Dy to the main configuration and multiplied by 162Er/166Er and 164Er/166Er
monitoring another isotope of the interfering element and subtracting its intensity at natural abundance

Uncertainty Level.cell: 95% confidence interval — Student's t, from the sample's own φE values with six or more brackets, otherwise from standards bracketed by standards

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: Partially — "On average, LREEs were measured nine times"; replicate matrix cuts were measured but "are not used, however, for data interpretation to avoid unnecessary influence of stable isotopic fractionation potentially induced by Mo chemistry" — an explicit exclusion, on chemical rather than statistical grounds

Combination Method.cell: all: per sample, over 1 to 12 (typically 5) STD-SMP-STD bracketings — 'The reported φE values were calculated based on 1 to 12 (typically 5) STD-SMP-STD bracketings'; Fig. 1 also shows the mean of seven CAIs

value.value: per sample, over 1 to 12 (typically 5) STD-SMP-STD bracketings

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: all [Ce, Nd, Sm, Eu, Gd, Dy, Er, Yb: OL-REE series]

Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.cell: Every sample, spaced by 300 s rinsing
Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.value: Every sample, spaced by 300 s rinsing

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Metho.cell: BCR-2 [all: zero within error bars, typically < 0.05‰/amu] — Assessment of data accuracy; replicates from the Mo-chemistry matrix cut agree, with LREEs shifted ~0.1‰/amu
